# Part 2: The Database

**The claim it adds.** Exactness survives a crash at any point; no acknowledged operation is lost; a multi-group deletion is all-or-nothing.

- **Spec:** §12, §14 (not §14.5, §14.7), §15, §16.1, §17 ([specification](../../docs/SEVER-DB_SPECIFICATION.md))
- **Status:** frozen, tag `part-2-frozen-e2`
- **Owned files:** 250 (`scripts/freeze.sh list 2`)
- **Demo:** `cargo run --release -p sever-p2 --features demo --bin sever-demo-p2 -- durable --data synthetic`
